official.programme: Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship to Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS)
official.university: Multiple Brunei Universities, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade programmes
official.funding_label: Full scholarship with tuition exemption and allowances
official.deadline_note: Applications for the 2026/2027 academic session opened on 15 December 2025 and the closing date was 15 February 2026. The scheme is announced annually by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, so the next session's dates are published on the same page.
official.status_note: The Ministry's page still publishes the 2026/2027 session notice: 'Applications will open on 15 December 2025' and 'The closing date for application of the Scholarship is 15 February 2026.' No dates for the next session have been published on that page yet.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Recipients are exempted from paying tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme.
benefits: Exemption from paying tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
An economy class air-ticket from Brunei Darussalam to the recipient's country of origin or country of domicile prior to the commencement of the course
An economy class air-ticket from Brunei Darussalam to the country of origin or country of domicile upon completion
A monthly personal allowance of BND$500.00
A monthly meals allowance of BND$150.00
An annual book allowance of BND$600.00
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Baggage allowance for shipment of personal effects upon completion, at a maximum of BND$250.00 to a country within the ASEAN region or BND$500.00 to a country outside the ASEAN region
Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration of the Scholarship
eligibility: Applicants must be eligible to begin study at the Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree level

Applicants must not have exceeded the age of 25 for Undergraduate and Diploma programmes, and the age of 35 for Postgraduate Master's Degree programmes, on the first day of July of the year when the course begins
Be proficient in English with a Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level Examination, a Grade 'C' in IGCSE English as a second language, an IELTS score of 6.0, or a TOEFL minimum score of 550
The Scholarship is intended primarily for international students studying for the first time in Brunei Darussalam

Ineligible applications include: Brunei Permanent Residents; international students who studied or graduated in Brunei before the announced closing date; candidates currently employed with Brunei Majesty's Government; candidates already studied in Brunei; non-eligible programme, study level or higher education institution candidates; non-submitted applications before the deadline; incomplete applications; dual Bruneian citizens; students with incomplete or inaccessible official transcript of results; and lazy reading students who missed supplementary application instructions
The Government of Brunei Darussalam considers eligibility based on all sections of the application
requirements: Applicants may be required to appear for an interview at such place(s) as may be determined by the institutions offering the programmes
Applicants may be required to sit a written examination to assess proficiency in the English/Malay/Arabic Language, where applicable
Certified English translations of supporting documents are required for documents that are not in English
Applicants must complete the official BDGS application form carefully and submit supporting documents completely
Applicants applying to universities that require an online application through the university's portal must complete that application separately
The Government of Brunei Darussalam reserves the right to reject any applications; the decision is final and disputes or enquiries will not be entertained
All costs incurred during the application process are borne solely by the applicant
documents: Certified English translations of supporting documents not in English
Certified true copies of birth certificate and passport
References and recommendations from referees C1 and C2
Certificate of National Language BAdST (if applicable)
Copy of Master's degree certificate and transcript (for Master's applicants)
Outline of the proposed research topic (for Master's applicants)
selection_criteria: Applications are screened by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Brunei Darussalam
Only successful applicants will be contacted or notified for further consideration in the selection process
Unsuccessful applicants will be notified through e-mail
Interview at location(s) determined by the institutions offering the programmes may be required
A written examination to assess proficiency in the English/Malay/Arabic Language may be required where applicable
coverage: Full tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
Economy class air ticket to Brunei before the course and return air ticket on completion
Monthly personal allowance of BND$500.00 and monthly meals allowance of BND$150.00
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Baggage allowance up to BND$250.00 to ASEAN countries or BND$500.00 outside the ASEAN region
Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration of the Scholarship
application_method: Read the BDGS advertisement published on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade page and follow the site for updates
Check the eligible programmes and institutions on the advertisement attachments
Complete the official BDGS Application Form
Upload all required documents in the application form
Additionally, if applying to Universiti Brunei Darussalam or Universiti Teknologi Brunei, complete the separate online application through those universities' own portals
official.application_route: Complete the Ministry's online BDGS Application Form with certified copies and translations; UDB and UTB applicants must also apply directly through those universities' own portals.
official.study_mode: Study at Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree level; the academic year commences July/August
official.citizenship_residency: International students studying in Brunei Darussalam for the first time. Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents, international students who studied or graduated in Brunei before the announced closing date, candidates currently employed with Brunei Majesty's Government, and dual Bruneian citizens are not eligible
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scheme is for foreign students tenable in Brunei Darussalam
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree programmes in the eligible programmes list at Universiti Brunei Darussalam, Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali, Universiti Teknologi Brunei, Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan or Politeknik Brunei. Only students studying in a full-time mode are eligible. Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Level, Brunei Darussalam GCE 'A' Level, Polytechnic (Diploma) and Higher National Diploma (HND) are not eligible for Master's programmes
official.research_requirement: For Master's applicants, an outline of the proposed research topic; a copy of the Master's degree certificate and transcript
official.duration: Diploma, undergraduate degree or postgraduate master's degree programme, full-time, commencing at the July/August academic year intake
official.description: The Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship to Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam is administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and covers Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree study at five Brunei institutions. Recipients are exempt from tuition fees, receive air tickets, a monthly personal allowance of BND$500.00, a monthly meals allowance of BND$150.00, an annual book allowance, residential college accommodation, a baggage allowance and comprehensive insurance.
official.english_requirement: Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level Examination, Grade 'C' in IGCSE English as a second language, IELTS score of 6.0, or TOEFL minimum score of 550. A written examination to assess English/Malay/Arabic proficiency may also be required where applicable.

verification.notes: Tuition fee exemption, the two air tickets, the BND$500.00 monthly personal allowance, BND$150.00 monthly meals allowance, BND$600.00 annual book allowance, residential college accommodation, baggage allowance up to BND$250.00 within ASEAN or BND$500.00 outside ASEAN, comprehensive insurance, age limits (25/35 as at 1 July), English requirements, the full list of ineligibility conditions, required documents including the research outline for Master's applicants, and the application and selection process were read directly on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade's own BDGS pages. The published dates are for the 2026/2027 session, which closed on 15 February 2026; no next-session dates have been published on those pages.

applicant_utility.summary: Brunei's BDGS is a genuinely complete package: full tuition fees, two economy air tickets, BND$500 a month personal allowance, BND$150 a month meals allowance, BND$600 a year for books, residential college accommodation, baggage allowance and comprehensive insurance for the whole programme. It is open to Diploma, Bachelor's and Master's students at five Brunei institutions, but the eligibility list is strict and unusually long: anyone who has previously studied or graduated in Brunei, Bruneians and Brunei Permanent Residents, dual citizens, and candidates currently employed by the Government of Brunei Darussalam are all excluded. The published 2026/2027 closing date was 15 February 2026, so the next round should open around December 2026.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Genuinely incoming international students aged 25 or under for Diploma and Bachelor's programmes (35 or under for Master's) who have never studied or graduated in Brunei, and whose English proof is in place. Because the Ministry screens for study level, programme and institution as well as application completeness, this suits applicants who can pick their programme strictly from Brunei's published eligible list rather than trying to study anything they like.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your programme and study level (Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree) appear on the current eligible list
Confirm your age as at 1 July of the year the course starts: 25 or under for Diploma/Undergraduate, 35 or under for Master's
Confirm your English proof: Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level, Grade 'C' in IGCSE English as second language, IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 550
Confirm you have never studied or graduated in Brunei, are not a Brunei Permanent Resident or citizen, and are not employed by the Government of Brunei Darussalam
Obtain certified true copies of your birth certificate, passport, certificates, testimonials and transcripts
Arrange certified English translations of anything not already in English
Identify referees C1 and C2 and request their references and recommendations
For Master's, prepare your Master's degree certificate, transcript and an outline of your proposed research topic
Complete the official BDGS Application Form and upload every document
If applying to UDB or UTB, complete the additional university portal application
common_rejection_risks: Submitting after the closing date, or an incomplete application - both are explicit ineligibility conditions
Having previously studied or graduated in Brunei, whether through your own studies or any prior programme
Being a Brunei Permanent Resident, a Brunei citizen or a dual Bruneian citizen
Being 26 or over at the start of the academic year for a Diploma or Bachelor's programme, or 36 or over for a Master's
Choosing a programme, study level or institution that is not on the eligible list
Applying for a Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Level, Brunei Darussalam GCE 'A' Level, Polytechnic Diploma or Higher National Diploma to enter a Master's programme
Submitting transcripts that are incomplete, unofficial or inaccessible
Applying to UDB or UTB without completing the separate university portal application
Failing to certify translations of non-English documents
Missing the supplementary instructions that the Ministry attaches to the announcement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The award covers tuition, accommodation, two air tickets, personal and meals allowances, books, insurance and baggage. What you still carry is the application itself - the Ministry states all costs incurred during the application process are borne solely by the applicant - plus personal expenses above the BND$500 monthly allowance and BND$150 monthly meals allowance.
applicant_utility.document_audit: Certification is the recurring theme: certified true copies of the birth certificate and passport, certified translations of non-English documents, and an accessible official transcript of results. For Master's applicants add the degree certificate, transcript and the research topic outline, which is the item most often left out.
alerts: The published 2026/2027 session closed on 15 February 2026; the round opened on 15 December 2025
The Ministry reserves the right to reject any application, and its decision is final with disputes or enquiries not entertained
Applications are made on the Ministry's official BDGS online application form, not through university portals alone
Applicants to Universiti Brunei Darussalam and Universiti Teknologi Brunei must additionally apply through those universities' own portals
A written examination in English/Malay/Arabic may be required where applicable
The only exceptions to the 'not previously studied in Brunei' rule are Brunei students who studied on a scholarship funded by their own country or by institutions from their own country
Scholarship holders are not allowed to transfer, change or discontinue their study course other than what has been applied for under the scheme
submission_workflow: Watch the Ministry's online-bdgs page for the annual announcement, expected around December
Read the full advertisement and the attached eligible-programme and institution lists
Check every ineligibility condition, especially the previous-study-in-Brunei and nationality conditions
Collect certified true copies of the birth certificate, passport, certificates, testimonials and transcripts
Secure references from referees C1 and C2
For Master's, write the research topic outline
Complete the official BDGS Application Form with all documents uploaded
If applying to UDB or UTB, complete the additional university application
Await notification - only successful applicants are contacted or notified for further consideration, and unsuccessful applicants are notified by e-mail
